example.title: CSR Marine boatyard on Salmon Bay, Ballard

brief: A small working boatyard on a fishing harbour (the present sheds 1970s-80s, year estimated): a white barrel-roofed boat shed and grey steel work sheds behind a timber bulkhead, blue travel-lift piers running out over the water, boats on stands in the yard, a floating dock of workboats and sailboats alongside. One photo from the water. Piles 10 m below the bed (spec rule 4).
